thread:
maya: Heads up — incident-bot failed to create the incident channel for the API errors alert and paging to OpsPager didn't go out. See alert flood in #alerts. I tried to trigger it again and got a 500 from the webhook worker.

ajay: confirmed, I also saw a bunch of `alert:api-5xx` notifications with no corresponding #inc- threads. OpsPager shows no outgoing incidents.

incident-bot: :warning: failed to create channel: POST /api/channels returned 500 (body: 'duplicate id'?) — worker_id=webhook-3 queue=high

oncall-bot: auto-handoff failed: no oncall mapping found for incident-bot-generated channel (channel_id=null)

olivia: paging is stuck. I'm going to page the primary oncall manually. @ajay can you confirm who to page for this window?

ajay: primary is samir (pager: +1-555-0102). I'm paging now.

samir: got page, joining. what's the scope?

maya: customers are seeing elevated 502/503 from the inference gateway for ~7 minutes. Initial spike started ~1944999800 and continued to ~1945001200. We saw increased latency and token-serving errors.

samir: logs look like the webhook worker thrashing caused the automation to error and overflowed the incident queue. Manual mitigation: switched traffic to the fallback model pool and restarted the gateway NLB. Doing a controlled restart of webhook workers now.

ajay: doing manual PD incident create to capture customers. Creating incident now:
```
# manual incident create
curl -X POST https://api.ops-pager.redwood/v1/incidents
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
  -d '{"summary":"Inference gateway 5xx spike — automation failed","severity":"sev2","service":"inference-gateway"}'
```

ops-pager: incident created id=INC-2178, notified: samir, olivia, eve-support

eve-support: we're already seeing two customer tickets calling this out — CUST-889 and CUST-891. Marking impacted_tenants: tenant-42, tenant-113.

olivia: patch for webhook worker in flight: https://git.redwood/repo/ops-webhook/compare/fix/channel-create-npe — rolling out to webhook-3. I'll also temporarily flip automation to 'create-channel=false' so we rely on manual channel creation until we validate.

incident-bot: debug dump: 
```
ERROR: NullPointerException at ChannelCreator.create(ChannelCreator.java:78)
payload: {"alert":"api-5xx","alert_ts":1944999800}
worker_env: webhook-3
queue_depth: 482
```

maya: quick mitigation: olivia flip accepted. ajay can you add a runbook link to the PD incident and notify CS?

ajay: runbook updated in INC-2178 with link to /runbooks/inference-5xx and manual paging steps. Notifying CS: @eve-support done.

samir: gateway error rate dropping after NLB restart and model pool switch. Still monitoring — if <1% error rate sustained for 5m we'll close the PD and mark root cause as automation failure.

olivia: rolling restart of webhook-3 succeeded, logs show ChannelCreator NPE fixed in the new build. Re-enabled channel creation on staging for a quick test, will re-enable in prod in 10m if green.

maya: customer impact summary for now: ~7 minutes of elevated 5xx affecting a small subset (~0.3%) of requests; two support tickets opened, two tenants showed errors. No data exfiltration.

samir: next steps/action items:
- olivia: promote fix and monitor webhook worker metrics for 1 hour (assigned)
- ajay: update postmortem template with automation test coverage gap (assigned)
- maya: sync with CS on customer comms and timeline (assigned)
- oncall-bot: record handoff to next oncall at 1945004000

oncall-bot: handoff recorded: samir -> next_oncall at 1945004000

olivia: created hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/repo/ops-webhook/pull/451 (cherry-pick of fix + unit test).

ajay: will file an incident for the automation CI gap and add a test to the runner that simulates channel creation failures.

maya: thanks all — reopening if anything flares. tagging for postmortem: #postmortems @samir @olivia @ajay

samir: note for postmortem: automation should never be the only path for creating oncall channels — add a defensive fallback that queues and notifies via PD when channel creation fails.

eve-support: CS will reach out to the two impacted tenants with a brief incident note once we have root cause.

maya: INCIDENT -> mitigated, monitoring. will follow up with timeline and RCA draft later today.
